# Bruiser Kit
You love a good scrap, and you never run from a fight.
Choose the [bold]Bruiser[/bold] kit from the Wastelander kit selector. Opening it gives you [bold]one random two-handed melee weapon[/bold], one psycho syringe, and one buffout pill.
## Weapon Chances
The [bold]super sledgehammer has a 2% chance[/bold] to appear.
The remaining 98% is split equally between these six weapons (approximately 16.33% each):
- Baseball bat - Sledgehammer - Fire axe - Golf club - Wasteland spear - Tribal decorated heavy club
Each kit contains exactly one weapon. The rare super sledgehammer replaces the ordinary weapon when rolled.
